method: Public official pages requested only after robots.txt returned HTTP 200 text/plain and the requested path was not disallowed. No login, checkout, invoice, coupon redemption or customer account was used. Official update dates were absent from the fetched Hosting.com/terms pages.
verified_now: The coupon page still states that the promotional price is for the first term only and renews at the regular rate.
The renewal pricing page still states that prepaid-period expiration leads to regular pricing.
The money-back guarantee page still contains its 30-day guarantee statement.
The official refund/billing and service-terms pages returned HTTP 200; the tested renewal timing, downgrade and customer-panel cancellation conditions matched.
The current refund/billing policy still contains the statement that Hosting.com is operated by A2 Hosting, LLC.
not_reverified: The published user guide still cites the October 3 capture for the A2/Hosting.com shared-operator wording and A2-site redirect. This live run did not establish a current redirect or match the operator sentence.
The Hosting.com migration FAQ URL in the supplied report now returns 404 at the plural address; the guide does not rely on that FAQ.
